title: achnatherum stillmanii
intro: Achnatherum stillmanii, commonly known as Stillman's needlegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Achnatherum stillmanii include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
